column1: # Level-3 exit chain (issue #39). `03_goals.cog` (placed cog 39) sends `user0(2)` to the master cog
# when the body enters goal sector 232; the master sleeps and calls `jkEndLevel(1)`.
# The body is placed in sector 250 and walks 250 -> 249 -> 232. A warp straight into 232 would send no
# `entered` (`sithThing_EnterSector` `0x4cd2c0` messages only a move, not a placement).
